text:
DevOps Engineer
Pinecraft Software
Salary: $4000–5000 gross
Fully remote

Pinecraft Software is a product company building a SaaS platform for construction project management, used by 900+ construction companies.

What you will do
- Run our Kubernetes clusters on AWS with Terraform and Helm
- Keep our GitLab CI pipelines fast and reliable
- Set up monitoring with Prometheus, Grafana and Loki

What we expect
- 3+ years in a DevOps role
- Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform
- AWS
- Bash and Python scripting
- English: Upper-Intermediate

What we offer
- 25 paid days off
- Home office budget
